description: A cafe-gallery in a leafy little yard on Fereshteh: vines, art events, specialty coffee, and a famous 'heavenly' breakfast. Deliberately no plugs or reliable wifi, so perfect for reading or a slow date. Garden tables in season. Open 13:00-23:00.
